verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's own materials describe team collaboration on collections: docs say collections organize requests 'for future reference or collaboration with your team', the GitHub README says it helps teams 'collaborate across your teams', and the changelog mentions 'Team search in workspace search'. The MCP docs also reference teams alongside collections. These mentions are glancing, though, and none documents how a shared team workspace is created or how collections sync between members. missing for 10: explicit documentation of shared team workspaces and real-time or synced collection updates, member/permission management for shared collections, independent hands-on corroboration of team sync.
